turns.replyText: Yes, in terms of the physics of sparkle—the way light bounces and refracts through the crystal structure—lab-grown and natural diamonds perform identically. They have the same refractive index and the same optical properties, so a lab-grown diamond will sparkle exactly as brilliantly as a mined diamond of the same cut and quality.The only way you could tell them apart by looking is if you knew to look for specific markers under magnification, and even then it requires specialized equipment. To the naked eye, they're visually indistinguishable.So if sparkle is what matters to you, both will deliver the same dazzle. The choice really does come down to budget, the story behind the stone, or personal values around sourcing.
